class CustomModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, hidden_size, output_size):
        super(CustomModel, self).__init__()
        self.weight1 = nn.Parameter(torch.Tensor(hidden_size, input_size))
        self.bias1 = nn.Parameter(torch.Tensor(hidden_size))
        self.weight2 = nn.Parameter(torch.Tensor(output_size, hidden_size))
        self.bias2 = nn.Parameter(torch.Tensor(output_size))
        self.softplus = nn.Softplus()

        self.model = nn.Sequential(
            self.softplus,
            self.weight1,
            self.bias1,
            self.softplus,
            self.weight2,
            self.bias2,
        )

    def forward(self, crys_fea):
        out = self.model(crys_fea)
        return out

def parity_plot(x, y,title,x_label,y_label,filename):
    # Calculate the point density
    xy = np.vstack([x,y])
    z = gaussian_kde(xy)(xy)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    scatter = ax.scatter(x, y, c=z, s=10, cmap='gist_rainbow_r')  # Reverse the colormap
    ax.plot([min(x), max(x)], [min(y), max(y)], 'r-')
    plt.xlabel(x_label)
    plt.ylabel(y_label)
    plt.title(title)
    plt.grid(True)

    # Add a colorbar
    cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter)
    cbar.set_label('Density')

    # Calculate and print the R-squared value
    r_squared = r2_score(y, x)
    plt.text(0.05, 0.95, f'R² = {r_squared:.2f}', transform=ax.transAxes)

    # Save figure
    plt.savefig(filename)

    plt.show()
